summary: Classic per-character sine wave, without forcing a text re-layout every frame.
overview: Offsets each character's mesh vertices in a running wave. It caches the clean, unanimated vertex positions once whenever the text changes rather than calling ForceMeshUpdate every frame — which avoids a full re-layout per frame and, more importantly, avoids the re-entrancy that made an earlier version recurse.
useCases: A title or banner with movement.
Emphasising a word or phrase in dialogue.
A floating, dreamlike look for narration.

params.tuning: In local text units, so the same value looks bigger on larger text.
Phase offset between adjacent characters. Higher makes a tighter ripple; very high starts to look like noise.

gotchas.title: It fights anything else that rewrites the mesh
gotchas.body: Another effect calling ForceMeshUpdate on the same text invalidates the cached positions. Combining per-character effects on one TMP_Text needs care.
